lines.japanese: 後輩の友人といえば、すでにひとり、いることはいる。
lines.english: Speaking of younger friends, I did already have one.

lines.japanese: 「ヒャハー！　アニキぃ～！」
lines.english: “Hyahaaa! Brooo!”

lines.japanese: 校門をくぐった辺りで、僕を呼ぶ声がした。
lines.english: I heard someone calling me just as I passed through the school gate.

lines.japanese: 振りむかずとも分かる。呼称といい声色といい、疑いようもなく彼だ。
lines.english: I didn't even have to turn around. Between the name and the voice, there could be no doubt who it was.

lines.japanese: 「は～いアニキ！　Ｆｕｃｋ　Ｍｏｒｎｉｎｇ！」
lines.english: “Heeey, Bro! Fuck morning!”

lines.japanese: 制服着用の義務と真っ向から戦いつづける、反骨精神豊かなパンクス。
lines.english: A punk rich in rebellious spirit, locked in an unending head-on battle with the rule requiring him to wear a uniform.

lines.japanese: 「おはよう。佐久間君は今日も元気だね」
lines.english: “Good morning. You're as energetic as ever today, Sakuma.”

lines.japanese: 「んイェス！　あんたに会えたこの良き朝を心からお慶び申しあげているのさァ、ギョイィィィーン！」
lines.english: “Nnnyes! From the bottom of my heart, I rejoice in this fine morning that has brought me unto you! GYOWEEEENG!”

lines.japanese: 空想ギターを掻きならしながら跳ねまわる縦ノリの彼は、かつて成田君だった僕を、ひょんなことから慕ってくれるようになった佐久間君だ。
lines.english: The boy bouncing to the beat while shredding an imaginary guitar was Yasuo Sakuma. By a strange turn of events, he had come to look up to the me who had once been Narita.

lines.japanese: 成田君と一緒になったいま、成田君の友達はすなわち僕の友達でもある。
lines.english: Now that Narita and I had become one, Narita's friends were my friends as well.

lines.japanese: 柳木原の繁華街を歩いていると、そうした新しくて懐かしい友人たちに出会うことがあった。
lines.english: Walking through downtown Yanagihara, I sometimes ran into those friends who were both new and familiar.

lines.japanese: 中でも『Ｒ‐ウィング』の面々とは、成田君だったころより更に親しくなることができた。
lines.english: I had grown even closer to the members of R-Wing than Narita had been.

lines.japanese: 僕自身が（針生さんや山科さんの影響で）結構なロックバードのファンになっていたからだ。
lines.english: That was because I myself had become quite a Rockbird fan, thanks to Hariu and Yamashina.

lines.japanese: とはいえ「Ｒ－ウィングの咲夜さん」が、僕の後輩「美空学園２年Ｂ組の佐久間安男君」だったと知ったのはつい数日前の話だ。
lines.english: That said, I had only learned a few days ago that Sakuya from R-Wing was none other than Yasuo Sakuma of Class 2-B at Misora Academy, my own underclassman.

lines.japanese: その日、山科さんとふたりで体育館へ向かっていたら、背後から奇声が近付いてきたんだ。
lines.english: That day, Yamashina and I had been on our way to the gym when a bizarre cry approached us from behind.

lines.japanese: 「ジャキィ～ん！　るるるるる瑠樺チャン見ィっけ～！　冴えない後ろ姿のオトコ連れてどっこ行くの～、なんつってクルッと回りこんじゃって、ご尊顔はいけーん──」
lines.english: “JAKIIING! R-r-r-r-Ruka, there you aare! Where’re you going with that guy? He looks pretty dull from back here. Lemme just whirl around and behold his noble visage—”

lines.japanese: 「──ってスポォォォーん！？」
lines.english: “—AND SPROOOOING?!”

lines.japanese: 彼は眼球を射出するような手振りと併せて、エビのように後ろへ跳んで尻餅をついた。
lines.english: He accompanied the cry with a gesture like his eyes were firing from their sockets, then sprang backward like a shrimp and landed on his ass.

lines.japanese: 「……？　どうしたの咲夜君」
lines.english: “...? What's wrong, Sakuya?”

lines.japanese: 「でえええええっ！　アニ、アニアニ、ぶしゃぶしゃぶしゃッ……アニキぃ～っ！？」
lines.english: “Deeeeeeh?! B-Bro, brobro, splurt-splurt-spluuurt... Brooooo?!”

lines.japanese: そして尿がだくだくと迸る手振りと併せて、僕を耳慣れない仇名で呼んだ。
lines.english: Then, while miming urine gushing forth in torrents, he addressed me by a nickname I had never heard before.

lines.japanese: 他の誰も呼びえないその呼称がトリガーになって、彼に関する成田君の記憶がそのときよみがえった。
lines.english: That name, which no one else could possibly have called me, pulled the trigger on Narita's memories of him.

lines.japanese: 「Ｒ‐ウィングの佐久間……君？　えっ、なんでうちの校舎に……？」
lines.english: “Sakuma from R-Wing... right? Wait, what are you doing at my school...?”

lines.japanese: 元からの僕も、以前モンキの地下で一度だけ彼に会ったことはあるけれど、どちらの記憶を探ってもその答えは見つからなかった。
lines.english: The original me had met him once before in the basement of Monki, but no matter which set of memories I searched, I found no answer.

lines.japanese: 「なァ～ん！　ぬゎんでって、そりゃあこっちの台詞でショ～！？　ぬゎんでアニキこと“貴方の街の便利屋さん”成田工務店が、学生コスプレして呑気に瑠樺チャンと歩ってんのさァ！」
lines.english: “Naaah! Whaddaya mean, what am I doing here? That's my line! Why's my bro—Narita Construction, your friendly neighborhood handyman—cosplaying as a student and strolling around with Ruka like he hasn't got a care in the world?!”

lines.japanese: 「同クラだから」
lines.english: “We're in the same class.”

lines.japanese: 「へ？　瑠樺ちゃん先輩と同じ……？　エッ？　てことは？」
lines.english: “Huh? You're in the same... class as Ruka? Wait. So that means...?”

lines.japanese: 「ドッギャアァァァ──ン！　衝撃の事実、アニキ、俺様ちゃんの先輩だったのォォォ！？」
lines.english: “DOGYAAAAAAN! The shocking truth! Bro, you've been my upperclassman this whole tiiiime?!”

lines.japanese: 「ああん、アニキ改めアニキ先輩～ん！　ヤスオ感激、これから毎日アニキ先輩に気合入れてもらえるなんて、はァん、あン、あふぅ……エクスタＣ～」
lines.english: “Aaaah, Bro has evolved into Senior Brooo! Yasuo is overwhelmed! Now I get to have Senior Bro pound some spirit into me every single day! Haaahn, ahn, ahuuu... Ecsta-C!”

lines.japanese: 「おれも驚いたよ。同じ学校だったんだ、これからもよろしくね」
lines.english: “I'm surprised too. I had no idea we went to the same school. Let's keep being friends, okay?”

lines.japanese: 「私も驚いたよ。羽田君と咲夜君、いつの間にかそんな仲？」
lines.english: “I'm surprised too. When did you and Sakuya get so close, Haneda?”

lines.japanese: 気付けば佐久間君は、僕の体にしがみついて腰を振っていた。
lines.english: By the time I noticed, Sakuma had wrapped himself around me and was thrusting his hips.

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや、違うよ山科さん。至って健全な仲だよ。前におれが女の子と歩いてたら佐久間君が刃物で脅してきて、それを返り討ちにしたら熱い友情が芽生えたってだけなんだ」
lines.english: “Oh, no, Yamashina, it's not like that. Our relationship is entirely wholesome. He threatened me with a knife once when I was walking with a girl, and after I turned the tables on him, a passionate friendship blossomed. That's all.”

lines.japanese: 「ヘヴィだね」
lines.english: “That's intense.”

lines.japanese: 「んイェス！　そーなの俺様、アニキの生き様にビビィーッってキちゃってェ！」
lines.english: “Nnnyes! Exactly! The way you live hit Yasuo right in the soul like BZZZAP!”

lines.japanese: 「ンもォ～、人生でリスペクトしたカリスマ的存在ベスト３中ふたりもが同じガッコだったなんて、糞ったれゴッドも粋なコトしてくれるじぇい！　じぇいじぇい！」
lines.english: “Maaaan! Who knew two of the top three charismatic figures I respect in this life went to the same school? Shit-for-brains God sure does have style! Jay! Jay-jay!”

lines.japanese: 「佐久間ッ！　おまえ、また私服で登校してきたな！」
lines.english: “Sakuma! You came to school in street clothes again!”

lines.japanese: 「ギャース！　権力の警吏が俺という自由の翼を捕えにきたじぇ！　ほんじゃねアニキぃ、またあとで～！」
lines.english: “Gyaaargh! The constable of authority has come to cage my wings of freedom! Catch ya later, Brooo! See you soooon!”

lines.japanese: 「こらあっ、待たんかあー！」
lines.english: “Hey! Get back here!”

lines.japanese: 「……あはは、面白いひとだね」
lines.english: “...Ahaha. He's funny.”

lines.japanese: 「直情的過ぎるきらいはあるけど、悪い子ではないよ」
lines.english: “He can be a little too impulsive, but he's not a bad kid.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yeah.”

lines.japanese: 後日聞いた話によれば、佐久間君はロックバードのハリュー・クロード、つまり僕のクラスの針生さんに憧れて美空学園を選んだらしい。
lines.english: I later heard that Sakuma had chosen Misora Academy because he admired Rockbird’s Claude Haryuu—in other words, Kuroudo Hariu from my class.

lines.japanese: しかし針生さんはアーティストとフォロワーが私的に交流することを良しとしない主義だし、そうでなくてもああいう性格だからまったく構ってもらえなくて、学園生活に諦めすら覚えていたという。
lines.english: But Hariu believed artists shouldn't socialize privately with their followers. Even without that principle, he was who he was, so he had paid Sakuma no attention at all, and Sakuma had nearly given up on school life.

lines.japanese: そんなとき僕に出会えて嬉しいと、彼はそう言ってくれた。こちらだって嬉しくなる。
lines.english: Then he met me. He told me he was glad he had, and hearing that made me glad too.

lines.japanese: 「でも、人前で話しかけられるとちょっと辛いよ」
lines.english: “Though it is a little hard when you talk to me in front of people.”
“Y-yeah...”

lines.japanese: そんなわけで、彼は僕を見かけるたび、こうして元気に駆けよってきてくれる。
lines.english: And that was why whenever he saw me, he came running over with all this energy.

lines.japanese: その強烈すぎる個性に多少戸惑いはするけれど、こうもあからさまに誰かから慕われるなんて、そうそうあることではないと思う。ありがたい話だ。
lines.english: His personality was so overpowering that it left me somewhat bewildered, but it wasn't often that anyone showed their affection for me so openly. I was grateful.

lines.japanese: 「Ｒ‐ウィングのみんな、最近はどう？」
lines.english: “How has everyone in R-Wing been lately?”

lines.japanese: 「ハハ～ん、あの親愛なる腐れフレンズども、みんなアニキに会いたがってるじぇ～。なァー、もっと頻繁に集会きてよォ」
lines.english: “Hahaaan, those dear rotten friends of mine all wanna see you, Brooo. Come to our get-togethers more often, would ya?”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう。出来るかぎりお邪魔させてもらうよ」
lines.english: “Thanks. I'll drop by whenever I can.”

lines.japanese: 山科さんの件があったから満夜さんとは正直ちょっと顔を合わせづらいんだけど……とは言わないでおいた。
lines.english: After what had happened with Yamashina, facing Mitsuyo was honestly a little awkward... but I kept that to myself.

lines.japanese: 「フレイムバーズのみんなとは？　仲良くしてる？」
lines.english: “And the Flame Birds? Are you getting along with them?”

lines.japanese: 「んァ？　ン～、ンンン～、まあねェ、アニキに言われちゃった以上、軽い口喧嘩以上の波風は立てないようにしてッけどさァ」
lines.english: “Hnn? Hmmm, hmmmm... more or less. Since you told me to, Bro, I haven't stirred up anything worse than a little yelling match.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう。でも、やっぱり喧嘩はよくないよ。みんな仲良く遊んだ方が楽しいでしょ？」
lines.english: “Thank you. But fighting still isn't good. Isn't it more fun when everyone plays together?”

lines.japanese: 「どうかねえ。やっぱ音楽性の違いっつーの？　その辺まだしっくり来ないトコあるけど──」
lines.english: “I dunno. Call it creative differences, I guess? Things still don't sit quite right with me there, but—”

lines.japanese: 「──あ。フレイムバーズっていや、こないだアニキが連れてた愛人、あの生理の重そうな胸パッドちゃんだけどさあ」
lines.english: “—oh! Speaking of the Flame Birds, there was that mistress you had with you the other day, Bro. That little chest-pad girl who looks like she gets killer periods.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　む、むねぱ……ド？」
lines.english: “What? Ch-chest... pad?”

lines.japanese: 誰？
lines.english: Who?

lines.japanese: おそらくは成田君だったときの僕に関連する事柄なんだろうけれど、ちょっと考えてみても記憶はまったく開かれない。
lines.english: It probably had something to do with me back when I was Narita, but even after I gave it some thought, no memories opened to me at all.

lines.japanese: 佐久間君にとっては印象的でも、成田君にとっては覚えるに足らない瑣末事だったんだろう。
lines.english: She may have made an impression on Sakuma, but to Narita she must have been too trivial to remember.

lines.japanese: 「ごめん、聞いていいかな。それって何のこと──」
lines.english: “Sorry, can I ask? What are you talking ab—”

lines.japanese: 「あ～ンるェェェ！？」
lines.english: “Haaang on a seeeeec!”

lines.japanese: 尋ねようとしたが、佐久間君がとつぜん僕の後ろへ首を伸ばした。
lines.english: I tried to ask, but Sakuma suddenly craned his neck to peer behind me.

lines.japanese: 「そこの陰にコソコソ隠れてんの、リンダ×２じゃ～ん？」
lines.english: “That you sneakin’ around in the shadows, Linda-Linda?”

lines.japanese: 「え？　りんだりん……ダ？」
lines.english: “Huh? Linda-Lin... da?”

lines.japanese: 誰？
lines.english: Who?

lines.japanese: それも成田君だったときの関係者なんだろうか。しかし考えてみても記憶はまったく開かれなかった。
lines.english: Was she another person connected to me from when I had been Narita? But no matter how I thought about it, no memory came to me.

lines.japanese: 「うッうぉ～い！　りりりりりリンダリンダちゅわ～ん！」
lines.english: “Heeey! L-L-L-L-Linda-Linda, babyyy!”

lines.japanese: 佐久間君が呼びかけている方向、つまり僕にとっての真後ろを振りかえってみた。
lines.english: I turned to look in the direction Sakuma was calling—that is, directly behind me.

lines.japanese: 誰もいない。もの言わぬ校門があるだけだ。
lines.english: Nobody was there. Only the silent school gate.

lines.japanese: 「ハァ～ん？　何しちゃってんのォ、リンダ×３！」
lines.english: “Huuuh? Whatcha doin’ there, Linda-Linda-Linda?”

lines.japanese: 「ウッシャッシャ、ストーカーじゃないんだからそんなとっから見てないで、あんたも俺らのボーイズトークに参加しちゃえよう！　オマエ週に何回自慰する～オレ４９回！　とかの話をしちゃおうＧ！」
lines.english: “Wushahaha! You're not some stalker, so quit watching from way over there and join our boys' talk! We can swap stories like, ‘How many times a week do you jack off? Me, forty-nine!’ C'mon, G!”

lines.japanese: 「うわああああーっ！」
lines.english: “Aaaaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 「なァ～ん、リンダ×２逃げちってん。恥ずかしがっちゃって、つれないネンネだＪ！　アンドＪ！」
lines.english: “Naaah, Linda-Linda ran away. So shy! What an unfriendly little baby J! And J!”

lines.japanese: 佐久間君はぴょんぴょん跳びはねながら、空中で繰り返しＪの人文字を作っていた。
lines.english: Sakuma bounced up and down, repeatedly contorting his body into the letter J in midair.

lines.japanese: 胸パッドとかリンダリンダとか、いったい何のことだろう。もしかしたら、僕や僕じゃなかった僕が覚えていないだけで、実は少なからず関わっている人物なのかもしれない。
lines.english: Chest pads, Linda-Linda... what was any of that about? Perhaps she really was someone who had been involved with me to some degree, and neither I nor the me who hadn't been me could remember her.

lines.japanese: 楽しそうに跳ねまわっているところ悪いけど、ちょっと佐久間君に聞いてみようかな。
lines.english: I hated to interrupt him while he was hopping around so happily, but perhaps I should ask Sakuma.
